announcements.text: Press Release - ABD Maestro Named  Company of the Year 2026  at Spiritz Conclave & Achievers  Awards 2026

Jindal Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 15, 2026, titled "Jindal Stainless deploys electric trucks for the first time, strengthens green mobility initiatives".
